question: What is the average of English books among all books published by Carole Marsh Mysteries?

sqlite_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.country = 'India', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T4.customer_id) FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN city AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.country_id INNER JOIN address AS T3 ON T2.city_id = T3.city_id INNER JOIN customer AS T4 ON T3.address_id = T4.address_id
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.country = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T4.customer_id), 0) FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN city AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.country_id INNER JOIN address AS T3 ON T2.city_id = T3.city_id INNER JOIN customer AS T4 ON T3.address_id = T4.address_id

question: Provide the full names and emails of customers whose payments were greater than 70% of the average.
evidence: full name refers to first_name, last_name; average payment refers to AVG(amount); payments were greater than 70% of the average refers to amount > (AVG(amount) MULTIPLY 0.7)
sqlite_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T2.email FROM payment AS T1 INNER JOIN customer AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id INNER JOIN address AS T3 ON T2.address_id = T3.address_id WHERE T1.amount > ( SELECT AVG(amount) FROM payment ) * 0.7
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T2.email FROM payment AS T1 INNER JOIN customer AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id INNER JOIN address AS T3 ON T2.address_id = T3.address_id WHERE T1.amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM payment) * 0.7

question: List down the full name of Irish patients diagnosed with the prevalent diseases that have an occurrence greater than the 96% of the average occurrences of all conditions.

sqlite_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.first, T2.last FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient INNER JOIN all_prevalences AS T3 ON T1.DESCRIPTION = T3.ITEM WHERE T2.ethnicity = 'irish' AND 100 * CAST(T3.OCCURRENCES AS REAL) / ( SELECT AVG(OCCURRENCES) FROM all_prevalences ) > 96
pg_gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.first, T2.last FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient INNER JOIN all_prevalences AS T3 ON T1.DESCRIPTION = T3.ITEM WHERE T2.ethnicity = 'irish' AND 100 * CAST(T3.OCCURRENCES AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(OCCURRENCES) FROM all_prevalences), 0) > 96

sqlite_gold_sql: SELECT SUM((T1.Sales / (1 - T1.Discount)) * T1.Quantity - T1.Profit) AS cost FROM east_superstore AS T1 INNER JOIN people AS T2 ON T1.`Customer ID` = T2.`Customer ID` INNER JOIN product AS T3 ON T1.`Product ID` = T3.`Product ID` AND T1.Region = T3.Region WHERE T1.Region = 'East' AND T2.`Customer Name` = 'Brad Thomas' AND strftime('%Y', T1.`Order Date`) = '2016'
pg_gold_sql: SELECT SUM((T1.Sales / NULLIF((1 - T1.Discount), 0)) * T1.Quantity - T1.Profit) AS cost FROM east_superstore AS T1 INNER JOIN people AS T2 ON T1."Customer ID" = T2."Customer ID" INNER JOIN product AS T3 ON T1."Product ID" = T3."Product ID" AND T1.Region = T3.Region WHERE T1.Region = 'East' AND T2."Customer Name" = 'Brad Thomas' AND TO_CHAR(CAST(T1."Order Date" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2016'

sqlite_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T4.calories > 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Recipe AS T1 INNER JOIN Quantity AS T2 ON T1.recipe_id = T2.recipe_id INNER JOIN Ingredient AS T3 ON T3.ingredient_id = T2.ingredient_id INNER JOIN Nutrition AS T4 ON T4.recipe_id = T1.recipe_id WHERE T3.category = 'cheese'
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T4.calories > 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM Recipe AS T1 INNER JOIN Quantity AS T2 ON T1.recipe_id = T2.recipe_id INNER JOIN Ingredient AS T3 ON T3.ingredient_id = T2.ingredient_id INNER JOIN Nutrition AS T4 ON T4.recipe_id = T1.recipe_id WHERE T3.category = 'cheese'

sqlite_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(T4.list_followers) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.list_id) FROM ratings AS T1 INNER JOIN lists_users AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id INNER JOIN movies AS T3 ON T1.movie_id = T3.movie_id INNER JOIN lists AS T4 ON T2.list_id = T4.list_id WHERE T3.movie_title LIKE 'Pavee Lackeen: The Traveller Girl' AND T1.rating_timestamp_utc LIKE '2011-03-27 02:06:34'
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(T4.list_followers) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T2.list_id), 0) FROM ratings AS T1 INNER JOIN lists_users AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id INNER JOIN movies AS T3 ON T1.movie_id = T3.movie_id INNER JOIN lists AS T4 ON T2.list_id = T4.list_id WHERE T3.movie_title LIKE 'Pavee Lackeen: The Traveller Girl' AND T1.rating_timestamp_utc LIKE '2011-03-27 02:06:34'

question: What is the average number of complaints on credit cards filed by clients from New York in the 3 consecutive years starting from 2015?

sqlite_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.`Complaint ID`) AS REAL) / 3 AS average FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN events AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.Client_ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.`Date received`) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2017' AND T1.city = 'New York City' AND T2.Product = 'Credit card'
pg_gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2."Complaint ID") AS REAL) / NULLIF(3, 0) AS average FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN events AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.Client_ID WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Date received" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') BETWEEN '2015' AND '2017' AND T1.city = 'New York City' AND T2.Product = 'Credit card'

question:

"?
